leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Each financial institution or creditor that offers or maintains one or more covered accounts must develop and implement a written Identity Theft Prevention Program (Program) that is designed to detect, prevent, and mitigate identity theft in connection with the opening of a covered account or any existing covered account. The Program must be appropriate to the size and complexity of the financial institution or creditor and the nature and scope of its activities.

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: The Program must include reasonable policies and procedures to:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Identify relevant Red Flags for the covered accounts that the financial institution or creditor offers or maintains, and incorporate those Red Flags into its Program;

context.text: The Program must include reasonable policies and procedures to:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Detect Red Flags that have been incorporated into the Program of the financial institution or creditor;

context.text: The Program must include reasonable policies and procedures to:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Respond appropriately to any Red Flags that are detected pursuant to paragraph (d)(2)(ii) of this section to prevent and mitigate identity theft; and

context.text: The Program must include reasonable policies and procedures to:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Ensure the Program (including the Red Flags determined to be relevant) is updated periodically, to reflect changes in risks to customers and to the safety and soundness of the financial institution or creditor from identity theft.

context.text: The Program must include reasonable policies and procedures to:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must provide for the continued administration of the Program and must:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Obtain approval of the initial written Program from either its board of directors or an appropriate committee of the board of directors;

context.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must provide for the continued administration of the Program and must:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Involve the board of directors, an appropriate committee thereof, or a designated employee at the level of senior management in the oversight, development, implementation and administration of the Program;

context.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must provide for the continued administration of the Program and must:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Train staff, as necessary, to effectively implement the Program; and

context.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must provide for the continued administration of the Program and must:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Exercise appropriate and effective oversight of service provider arrangements.

context.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must provide for the continued administration of the Program and must:

leaves.heading: § 681.1 Duties regarding the detection, prevention, and mitigation of identity theft.
leaves.text: Each financial institution or creditor that is required to implement a Program must consider the guidelines in appendix A of this part and include in its Program those guidelines that are appropriate.

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: This section applies to a person described in § 681.1(a) that issues a debit or credit card (card issuer).

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: For purposes of this section:

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: means a consumer who has been issued a credit or debit card.

context.text: For purposes of this section:

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: means reasonably understandable and designed to call attention to the nature and significance of the information presented.

context.text: For purposes of this section:

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: A card issuer must establish and implement reasonable policies and procedures to assess the validity of a change of address if it receives notification of a change of address for a consumer's debit or credit card account and, within a short period of time afterwards (during at least the first 30 days after it receives such notification), the card issuer receives a request for an additional or replacement card for the same account. Under these circumstances, the card issuer may not issue an additional or replacement card, until, in accordance with its reasonable policies and procedures and for the purpose of assessing the validity of the change of address, the card issuer:

leaves.heading: § 681.2 Duties of card issuers regarding changes of address.
leaves.text: Notifies the cardholder of the request:

leaves.text: A card issuer may satisfy the requirements of paragraph (c) of this section if it validates an address pursuant to the methods in paragraph (c)(1) or (c)(2) of this section when it receives an address change notification, before it receives a request for an additional or replacement card.

leaves.text: Any written or electronic notice that the card issuer provides under this paragraph must be clear and conspicuous and provided separately from its regular correspondence with the cardholder.
